praise.name: AMMAAN
praise.description: Saacadaha hore ee ducadaada waxaad ku bilowdaa ammaanta Rabbiga ama adoo Rabbiga u mahadnaqaya. Isaga hadda ku ammaan waxyaalaha maskaxdaada ku jira. Isaga ku ammaan hal wax oo gaar ah oo uu noloshaada kuu sameeyay Toddobaadkan la soo dhaafay. Isaga u mahadnaq wanaagga uu qoyskaaga u sameeyey.

wait.name: SUG
wait.description: Wakhti qaado oo Rabbiga sug. Aamus oo u ogolow inuu kuu muujiyo waxa uu doonayo.

confess.name: QIRO
confess.description: Ruuxa Quduuska ah weydii inuu kuu muujiyo waxyaabaha aan ka farxin ee noloshaada ka mid ah. Waydiiso inuu ku tuso dabeecadahaaga khaldan iyo khaladyo gaar ah oo aad wali ka toobadkeenin ama aadan dembi dhaaf weydiisan. Laakiinse, hadda Rabbiga hortiisa qiro si uu dembiyadaada kaaga daahiriyo.

read_the_word.name: AKHRISKA ERAYGIISA/KITAABKA
read_the_word.description: Wakhti qaado oo akhriso Kitaabka Sabbuurradda, ama nebiyada ama farrimaha ku sugan Axdiga Cusub.

ask.name: WAYDII
ask.description: Codsi duco oo shaqsiyadaada ku saabsan samee.

intercession.name: U SHAFEECO QAAD
intercession.description: Codsi duco dadka kale u samee.

pray_the_word.name: KU DUCEYSO EREYADAN
pray_the_word.description: Ku ducayso farriino ama qeybto gaar ah oo ka tirsan Kitaabka sida Sabuurka oo si fiican u qeexeysa arimahan.

thank.name: MAHADNAQ
thank.description: Rabbiga ugu mahadnaq noloshaada adigoo matalaya qoyskaaga, iyo Kiniisaddadabe.

sing.name: QASIIDO
sing.description: Qaad qasiidooyin aad Rabbiga ku ammaanayso oo aad ku caabudayso.

meditate.name: U FIIRSASHO
meditate.description: Weydii inuu Rabbiga kula hadlo. Diyaarso qalin iyo bug aad ku qorto fariimihii uu ku siiyey.

listen.name: DHAGEYSI
listen.description: Wakhti qaado oo isku day inaad dhamaan isku wada keentid waxyaalihii aad akhriday, ka duceysatay, qasiidooyinkii aad qaaday si aad u fahamtid siyaabaha wada jirka ah ee uu Rabbigu kuula hadlayo.

praise_end.name: AMAAN
praise_end.description: Rabbiga ammaan ama ugu mahadnaq wakhtiga qiimaha badan ee aad Isaga la qaadatay iyo fariimaha aad ka heshay. Rabbiga ku ammaan dabeecadihiisa sharafta iyo weynaanta leh.

aria.next_step: U gudub tallaabada tukashada ee xigta
aria.restart_cycle: Dib uga bilow wareegga tukashada bilowga

audio.title: Codka
audio.description: Ciyaar codad jilicsan marka la wareegayo talaaboyinka salaadda

screen.title: Shaashadda
screen.keep_awake: Ilaali shaashadda oo toosan inta salaadda ah
screen.description: Ka hor-tag shaashadda in ay mugnaato ama damiso inta ku dhex jirta shirarka salaadda
screen.not_supported: Xirashada toosinta shaashadda looma taageero biraawsarkan
